meta.title: Window memory
meta.description: Check, re-apply, or revert DeepSeek Harness Desktop window-size memory. The window geometry is saved and restored by an Electron main-process patch inside app.asar; a DSH upgrade replaces that file, and this plugin detects that, re-installs the patch from a settings switch, verifies it, and keeps a pristine backup for a one-step revert.
